aboutH2: UMATTERCARE: Nurse-Led Mental Health and Addiction Care in Etobicoke
intro: UMATTERCARE, located in Toronto, Ontario, offers personalized care to individuals struggling with addiction and mental health issues. Their holistic approach aims to address the mind, body, and spirit, allowing them to effectively treat the root cause of addiction and/or mental health problems. UMATTERCARE offers a wide range of therapies and wellness activities, which can be tailored to meet the unique needs of each client.

Some of the services provided by UMATTERCARE include RN-led at-home detox support, individual, couple, and family therapy sessions, life skills training, relapse prevention, art therapy, journaling, dance classes, massage therapy, yoga, outdoor activities, socialization, financial management, weekly shopping trips, and independence and self-control training.
By providing an individualized approach, UMATTERCARE is able to help individuals on their journey to recovery in a personalized and effective manner.

pillars.title: An Etobicoke Office, Video Sessions and Care at Home
pillars.body: UMATTERCARE works out of an office at 97 Bonnyview Drive in Etobicoke, on Toronto's west side, and calls itself a practice for psychotherapy, counselling and addiction support. You can meet in person there or by secure video from anywhere in Ontario, and evening appointments make it easier to fit sessions around work or kids. People who want to stop drinking or using at home can have a Registered Nurse assess and monitor them there through early withdrawal. The office is a short drive from Mississauga and Oakville and the rest of the GTA.

pillars.title: Support That Carries On After the First Few Weeks
pillars.body: The centre treats recovery as ongoing work, and says it stays with people who are just starting out as well as those trying to keep progress they made a while ago. Partners and family can come in for couples or family therapy, which the centre offers to families supporting someone through addiction or mental health problems. There's also life skills coaching for practical things like budgeting, routines, cooking and keeping appointments. For a lot of people those everyday pieces matter most in the months after they stop.

pillars.title: Led by a Nurse Who Is Also a Psychotherapist
pillars.body: Loreta Doga founded UMATTERCARE. She's a Registered Nurse (RN-BN) regulated by the College of Nurses of Ontario and a practising psychotherapist, with more than 11 years of clinical experience. Few therapists have nursing training, and it shows in sessions: if something you describe points to a physical or medical problem, she's trained to pick it up. She works with evidence-based methods, including CBT and DBT, and adjusts them to the person in front of her. In March 2025 she received the Excellence in Healthcare Award at the Health 2.0 Conference in Las Vegas.

location.heading: UMATTERCARE Mental Health and Addiction Services in Etobicoke, Ontario
location.intro: UMATTERCARE's office is on Bonnyview Drive in south Etobicoke, in Toronto's west end, about 20 minutes by car from downtown Toronto and about the same from Mississauga. Oakville and Brampton are roughly half an hour away, Hamilton is closer to 50 minutes, and anyone elsewhere in Ontario can book secure video sessions instead.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does UMATTERCARE cost? Can I use my benefits?
faqs.a: UMATTERCARE doesn't publish its fees online, so ask about current rates during the free 15-minute consult. You pay at each session and get a detailed receipt to claim from your extended health plan, because the practice doesn't bill insurers directly. Plans differ, so check with your insurer that it covers services from a Registered Nurse or psychotherapist and whether you need a doctor's referral.

No. Its website describes an outpatient practice for psychotherapy, counselling and addiction support, with in-person sessions at the Etobicoke office, secure video sessions anywhere in Ontario and nurse-led detox support in your own home. The site doesn't mention overnight or live-in stays, so if you need a residential program, ask the team on your first call and they can point you to other options.

Yes, as at-home detox support led by a Registered Nurse regulated by the College of Nurses of Ontario. It starts with a nursing assessment, then the nurse monitors and supports you at home through early withdrawal and helps line up physicians or addiction programs for what comes next. If your situation needs physician oversight or more medical care, the team says it will tell you plainly and help you find it.

faqs.q: Where is UMATTERCARE and how do I get there?
faqs.a: The office is at 97 Bonnyview Drive in Etobicoke, in Toronto's west end (M8Y 3G8). It's roughly 20 minutes by car from downtown Toronto and about the same from Mississauga. If travel is hard, you can also meet the team by secure video from anywhere in Ontario. Call 416-822-0132 to book a time before you come.

UMATTERCARE was founded by Loreta Doga, a Registered Nurse (RN-BN) regulated by the College of Nurses of Ontario who also works as a psychotherapist. She has more than 11 years of clinical experience with anxiety, depression, trauma, grief and addiction. In March 2025 she received the Excellence in Healthcare Award at the Health 2.0 Conference in Las Vegas.

faqs.q: Does UMATTERCARE run court-referred DUI and PAREP programs?
faqs.a: Yes. The DUI program is designed to meet court and licensing body requirements, and the Partner Abuse Response and Education Program (PAREP) is court-accepted. You get documentation when you finish. Requirements vary from one referral to the next, so confirm what you need with your court, probation officer or licensing body before you start.
